index.title: Services
index.lead: We start with an audit, define the core of the business, build the system, package the brand, bring in clients and support deals. Each area works on its own; together they work as one team.

directions.name: Audit
directions.phrase: Every engagement starts with an audit: we find where the business loses money and clients, and what will drive growth fastest.
directions.result: Map of problems and opportunities · priorities · roadmap · budget
directions.note: “Financial audit” here means management-level financial diagnostics of a business, not a statutory audit of financial statements. “Investment” means investing in your own business, not securities advice.

services.name: Business & marketing audit
services.line: Product, positioning, funnel, customer journey and the sales team.
includes: customer journey from lead to payment
services.result: A structured diagnosis and a map of problems and opportunities.

services.name: Financial audit
services.line: Unit economics, P&L, cash flow, profitability of channels and business lines.
services.result: A clear picture of where the business earns and where it loses.

services.name: Investment & spending recommendations
services.line: Where to invest, what to cut, and what budget growth requires.
services.result: A financial plan for change, with numbers.

services.name: Strategy & roadmap
services.line: Priorities, a 3–12 month plan and KPIs.
services.result: A plan you can execute with us or on your own.

directions.name: Systems
directions.h2: A foundation where no lead gets lost.
directions.phrase: We connect the website, CRM, telephony and AI into one linked system: every lead is visible, counted and taken through to the sale.
directions.result: Website · CRM · telephony · AI · automation — in one system

services.name: Turnkey websites
services.line: From prototype and copy to launch, analytics and support.
includes: landing pages, corporate websites, online stores
services.result: A website that brings in leads and is connected to sales.

services.name: CRM: implementation & setup
services.line: Pipelines, automated tasks, integrations with the website, ads and messengers.
includes: platform selection [PLACEHOLDER: which CRMs we work with]
services.result: No lead gets lost; sales become transparent.

services.name: Telephony
services.line: IP telephony, call recording and analytics, call tracking, CRM link-up.
services.result: Every call is recorded and tied to a deal and a source.

services.name: AI tools & agents
services.line: Lead qualification, AI analysis of calls and chats, assistants, automated reports.
includes: analysis of calls and WhatsApp conversations
content systems, AI avatars and video generation
services.result: AI that works inside the process rather than impressing in a pitch.

services.name: Digitalisation & automation
services.line: End-to-end analytics, Make / n8n / API integrations, automation of internal processes.
services.result: Processes that don't depend on manual work or anyone's memory.

directions.name: Brand & content
directions.phrase: We define the brand core and turn it into content that sells, not content that merely goes out on schedule.
directions.result: Brand core · production · SMM · PR · personal brand

services.name: Positioning & brand core
services.line: Product, audience, value, difference, offer, message.
includes: the 8 elements of the Core: product, audience, positioning, value, difference, offer, message, brand DNA
services.result: A brand core that the website, content and advertising all build on.

services.name: Production
services.line: Photo, video, reels and ad creatives.
services.result: Content ready to publish and to run in ads.

services.name: SMM
services.line: Strategy, content plan, account management, community and reporting.
services.result: Social media that works for trust and sales.

services.name: PR
services.line: Media, newsworthy stories, reputation and events.
services.result: A brand present where people already trust.

services.name: Personal brand
services.line: Expert positioning, a content system, product and course launches.
services.result: A name that sells. Experience: six years with Oleksandr Usyk's personal brand.

directions.name: Traffic
directions.h2: Clients from every channel. With clear economics.
directions.phrase: We launch and run advertising wherever your audience is. We count CPL, CAC and ROMI, not clicks.
directions.result: CPL · CAC · ROMI — for every channel

services.name: Paid social
services.line: Instagram, Facebook and other social networks: audiences, creatives, tests, scaling.
services.result: A steady flow of leads at a controlled cost.

services.name: Google Ads
services.line: Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube and remarketing.
services.result: Hot demand from search with clear payback.

services.name: TikTok Ads
services.line: Native-format creatives, Spark Ads and lead generation.
services.result: A new client channel with a low cost per contact.

services.name: SEO
services.line: Technical audit, keyword research, content, links and local SEO.
services.result: Organic traffic that grows without paying per click.

directions.name: Tenders & legal
directions.phrase: We find tenders, prepare bids and manage the deal legally: from documentation to a signed contract.

services.name: Tender monitoring & analysis
services.line: We find suitable procurements and assess the odds before bidding.
services.result: A list of tenders worth bidding for.

services.name: Bid preparation & documentation
services.line: We prepare the documents, submit the bid and support it through to the contract.
services.result: A correct bid, submitted on time.

services.name: Contract work
services.line: Drafting, reviewing and supporting contracts.
services.result: Deals where the risks were handled in advance.

services.name: Corporate support
services.line: Corporate documentation and legal coordination of the business.
services.result: Order in the paperwork and predictability in disputes.
